name: Hilbert–Smith conjecture
question: Must a locally compact group acting faithfully on a finite-dimensional manifold be a Lie group?
first_attack: Audit precise statement and prove a restricted case
dispatch_next: Compare exact source hypotheses to a specialist formulation and obtain an expert check of the central p-adic action argument.
dispatch_why: A manuscript may already settle this entry. The next step is the review's own check, not a new lemma.

claim_review_2026.primary_title: The Hilbert–Smith conjecture in every finite dimension
claim_review_2026.claimed_theorem: Every locally compact second-countable Hausdorff group acting faithfully and jointly continuously on a connected, second-countable, Hausdorff finite-dimensional topological manifold without boundary is Lie.
claim_review_2026.scope_note: Very close to the classical manifold formulation, but connectedness, boundary, second-countability and joint continuity are explicit. Check equivalence to the intended M037 scope.
claim_review_2026.known_caveats: No independently accepted proof found; must scrutinize reduction to p-adic group actions and high-dimensional hypotheses, not just announced theorem wording.
claim_review_2026.next_review: Compare exact source hypotheses to a specialist formulation and obtain an expert check of the central p-adic action argument.
